steps.title: Merge Metaphlan tables
steps.instruction: Create an output directory and run the MetaPhlAn merge script on all profiled sample text files, saving the combined relative‑abundance table.

steps.title: Generate abundance heatmap
steps.instruction: Create an image output directory and run the MetaPhlAn heatmap script with hierarchical clustering using the merged table, selecting species‑level abundances, logarithmic scaling, the 25 most abundant clades, a minimum value of 0.1, and a custom colour map.

steps.title: List heatmap script options
steps.instruction: Display the full list of command‑line options for the heatmap and clustering script.
